input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 satisfies the checklist at or above the preferred level. 19.1 warrants Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner and that Services and Deliverables will materially conform to their documentation; 19.2 gives Deliverables a 90-day conformance period and warrants the hosted software (within the defined "Services", § 1.7) will conform throughout the subscription term, which equals or exceeds the 12-month software / 90-day services parameters; 19.3 adds Applicable Law compliance and a no-malicious-code warranty; and 19.4 provides re-performance, repair or replacement plus a refund of Fees paid, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. 19.5 confirms no disclaimer limits an express warranty, so the disclaimer does not swallow the warranty. Minor points noted only: the malicious-code warranty is qualified to code "intentionally introduced by Vendor", and the Deliverable conformance period is 90 days rather than a flat 12 months; neither is material given the full-term hosted conformance warranty and the acceptance-cycle refund right in 6.2. No redline needed.
